profile.about: I'm a senior software engineer with 10+ years of professional experience, focused on web development in the finance and crypto space. I’ve worked across a wide range of environments from early-stage startups and scaleups to large organizations. My primary programming languages are TypeScript and C#. I’m also an active open-source contributor, committed to delivering high-quality software to the community.

responsibilities: Owned backend components of the on-ramp/off-ramp cryptocurrency flow within the Risk & Compliance domain. Improved user verification speed and reliability, leading to higher conversion during KYC and onboarding while maintaining full regulatory compliance.

Owned backend microservices coordinating production workflows across Pfizer’s global manufacturing units and developed a frontend that visualized component production. Collaborated closely with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions that improved operational efficiency and streamlined decision-making.

Led and architected an algorithmic trading platform to bootstrap a private family-and-friends investment fund for founders, designing both the system and the trading strategies. Collaborated with data scientists to refine and improve performance, achieving over 100% returns in the first year. Managed funds, development, deployment, and infrastructure, and prepared weekly performance reports for investors.

Led the development and maintenance of a KYC system, building microservices that automated client verification and risk assessment, along with a frontend used by analysts and operations teams. Served as the primary technical owner for the system, supporting stakeholders across the organization.

Architected and developed a mobile navigation application for iOS and Windows to support helicopter and aircraft pilots during all flight operations. Collaborated closely with stakeholders to align the solution with real-world aviation needs and ensure reliability in mission-critical environments.

Developed a cross-platform MMO strategy game for iOS, Android, and Facebook. Implemented network optimizations using prediction and request batching, and integrated payment providers such as Xsolla, Google Play, and the App Store to deliver seamless in-game purchasing experiences.

Developed a PoC multiplayer third-person desktop shooter for Wargaming, implementing network synchronization and replication components to deliver a smooth and engaging gameplay experience. Ensured the PoC met all technical requirements and exceeded stakeholder expectations.

Ported a suite of flagship products from legacy technology to the Unity 3D platform, improving performance and user experience while successfully bringing a series of popular time-management strategy games from PC to mobile.

Researching and implementing market-neutral trading strategies on Solana with the goal of delivering stable, low-risk ~20% annual returns. Developed on-chain keepers and integrated Solana ecosystem protocols including Jupiter, Drift, and Pyth to support automated execution.

Created an open-source Node.js library in TypeScript for building reactive algorithmic trading strategies using RxJS. Designed a unified interface for multiple crypto exchanges and built tooling for strategy execution and management.

Developed a secure messaging mobile application, implementing end-to-end encryption based on the Bitcoin blockchain. Built a communication protocol on top of Bitcoin to ensure strong security and data integrity for users.
Developed a Yahoo Flurry Analytics plugin for Unity 3D using C#, Java, and Objective-C, enabling developers to easily integrate analytics into their Unity-based mobile games.

Developed an Apple StoreKit plugin for Unity 3D that enables developers to easily add in-app purchase functionality to their iOS games. Implemented secure transaction handling, receipt validation, and subscription management, simplifying the process of monetizing games on the App Store.
